title: adamupdate
summary: Report unsupported Adam optimizer state updates with a deterministic error.
description: `adamupdate` is registered but full optimizer-state semantics over model gradients remain outside this slice.
behaviors: The builtin returns a deterministic unsupported-optimizer error without materializing inputs.
Adam state updates for numeric arrays, dlarray values, model parameter structures, and GPU residency remain future work.

examples.output: RunMat reports that optimizer updates are not yet implemented.

gpu_residency: Optimizer execution is not implemented in this slice; provider-resident update kernels remain future work.
